csv_project_name: AE for TSU Agricultural Sciences Building
csv_scope_of_work: Construction of a new Tarleton State University Agricultural Sciences Building. The new four-story Agricultural Sciences Building will house updated laboratory, teaching, student, and administrative spaces for the Tarleton campus, including four departments. The facility will have a total of 113,500 Gross Square Feet (GSF), including 100,500 Priority 1 GSF and 13,000 Priority 2 GSF. The new building is proposed to be predominantly four floors, with heavy traffic and classrooms on the first floor. Offices, smaller classrooms, teaching labs and research labs will be located on the upper floors. To be located adjacent to the Engineering Building, nearest the intersection of Lillian and West Washington Streets.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering

title: AE for TSU Agricultural Sciences Building
short_description: Design services for a new four-story agricultural sciences university building in Stephenville, Texas.
project_scope: Construction of a new Tarleton State University Agricultural Sciences Building for the Tarleton campus. The building will have 113,500 gross square feet, including 100,500 Priority 1 GSF and 13,000 Priority 2 GSF. It is planned as a predominantly four-story facility with heavy traffic areas and classrooms on the first floor, and offices, smaller classrooms, teaching laboratories, and research laboratories on the upper floors. The building will house four departments and be located adjacent to the Engineering Building near the intersection of Lillian and West Washington Streets.
services: Architectural services, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- University building projects are generally of interest to sbp, especially on campuses.
- Structural engineering is explicitly requested, creating a potential entry point for sbp.
- The building is relatively large at 113,500 GSF.
- However, it appears to be a conventional academic building without notable long spans, special structures, or unusual structural features.
- The tender is multidisciplinary and architecture-led rather than focused on a distinctive structural challenge.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available scope information for estimating: new university building, 113,500 GSF, four stories, laboratories, teaching spaces, offices, and classrooms in Stephenville, Texas. Because laboratory buildings can vary widely in specification and cost, no reliable USD estimate is provided from the given information alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. The notice is for AE/RFQ services covering architecture and multiple engineering disciplines, including structural engineering, but no budget, fee percentage, or compensation basis is provided.
